description: This Java class defines a handler named NoVisitAssignmentHandler that extends BaseEncounterVisitHandler. It is part of the OpenMRS API and is responsible for managing encounter visit assignment behavior, specifically indicating that it does not assign encounters to visits.

classes.name: NoVisitAssignmentHandler
classes.description: A handler class in the OpenMRS API that signifies no visit assignment occurs for encounters.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a localized display name for the handler, indicating 'No Assignment' for visit assignment.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter
methods.description: A hook method that is called before creating an encounter, performs no action in this implementation.
